title: Could AI technologies be harnessed to break down barriers to inclusivity for women entrepreneurship in tourism?
core_idea: Explore whether and how responsible AI, interpreted through Rawls' theory of justice, can be harnessed to foster a more equitable and inclusive entrepreneurial ecosystem for women in the tourism sector using qualitative interviews and focus group data.
tldr: Examines the potential of ethically designed and governed AI to support greater inclusivity for women entrepreneurs in tourism, framed by Rawlsian justice and investigated via qualitative methods.
